result:
The bug was in the `mean` function in `stats.py`. It was dividing by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`, which caused the mean of `[2, 4, 6]` to be calculated as `12 / 2 = 6` instead of the correct `12 / 3 = 4`.

The fix was to change `len(values) - 1` to `len(values)`.

All tests now pass.
